items.title: # Launch New Product
items.content: Generate a marketing campaign for [Product/Service] targeting [Audience] to achieve [Goal]. Suggest 3 channels and core messages.

items.title: # Social Media Strategy
items.content: Develop a social media campaign for [Company Name] to increase engagement among [Target Demographic]. Provide 3 platform-specific content ideas for [Platform].

items.title: # Lead Generation Funnel
items.content: Create a lead generation campaign for [Industry] focusing on [Specific Product/Service]. Outline 3 actionable strategies to attract and convert new prospects.

items.title: # Customer Retention Plan
items.content: Design a customer retention campaign for [Business Type] to improve loyalty. Suggest 3 personalized communication ideas and a simple loyalty program concept.

items.title: # Marketing Tactic Breakdown
items.content: Analyze [Competitor Name]'s marketing for [Product/Service]. Identify key channels, messaging, and target audience. List strengths and weaknesses.

items.title: # SWOT Competitor Analysis
items.content: Perform a SWOT analysis for [Competitor Name] regarding their [Product/Service]. Focus on their current market position and recent activities.

items.title: # Feature Comparison Grid
items.content: Create a feature comparison table between our [Product Name] and [Competitor Product Name]. Include [3-5 Key Features] and highlight differences.

items.title: # Pricing Strategy Deepdive
items.content: Describe the pricing strategy of [Competitor Name] for their [Product/Service]. Include pricing tiers, discounts, and value propositions. Suggest potential counter-strategies.

items.title: # Analyze Competitors Fast
items.content: Identify [Number] key competitors for [Product/Service] in the [Industry] market. For each, list their strengths, weaknesses, target audience, and unique selling propositions.

items.title: # Create Buyer Persona
items.content: Develop a detailed buyer persona for [Product/Service]. Include demographic info, goals, pain points, preferred communication channels, and how [Product/Service] addresses their needs.

items.title: # Spot Market Trends
items.content: List the top 5 emerging market trends in the [Industry] sector. Explain how each trend could impact businesses and suggest potential opportunities for [Your Company/Product].

items.title: # Gather Product Feedback
items.content: Design a survey with 5 open-ended questions to gather feedback on [Product Feature/New Idea] from [Target Audience]. Focus on usability, value, and areas for improvement.

items.title: # Define Your Niche
items.content: Analyze my business idea: [Idea]. Who is the ideal target audience? Describe their demographics, pain points, and needs in detail.

items.title: # Assess Market Demand
items.content: For my business idea: [Idea], what is the current market demand? Identify potential competitors and suggest ways to differentiate.

items.title: # Uncover Business Hurdles
items.content: Evaluate the feasibility of my business idea: [Idea]. What are the biggest challenges or risks? Suggest mitigation strategies.

items.title: # Craft Value Proposition
items.content: Help me articulate a clear value proposition for my business idea: [Idea]. What unique problem does it solve for [Target Audience]?

items.title: # Craft Cold Outreach
items.content: Draft a personalized cold email for [Prospect Name] about [Product/Service]. Highlight [Specific Benefit 1] and [Specific Benefit 2]. Keep it concise and professional.

items.title: # Write Follow Up
items.content: Write a polite follow-up email to [Prospect Name] regarding our previous conversation about [Topic]. Reiterate [Key Value Proposition] and suggest [Next Step].

items.title: # Develop Value Pitch
items.content: Create a compelling, benefit-driven pitch for [Company Name] focusing on how [Product/Service] solves [Specific Problem] for their [Target Audience]. Emphasize [Key Outcome].

items.title: # Address Sales Objections
items.content: Provide three concise and effective responses to the sales objection: "[Specific Objection]". Focus on empathy, reframing, and offering solutions.

items.title: # Write Professional Email
items.content: Draft a professional email to [Recipient Name/Role] regarding [Topic]. The purpose is to [Purpose]. Keep it concise and polite.

items.title: # Craft Outreach Email
items.content: Write a compelling outreach email to [Potential Client/Partner] about [Product/Service]. Highlight [Benefit 1] and [Benefit 2]. Include a clear call to action: [Call to Action].

items.title: # Send Follow-up Email
items.content: Generate a polite follow-up email to [Recipient Name] about [Previous Interaction/Topic]. Remind them of [Key Point] and ask for [Desired Action/Information].

items.title: # Draft Apology Email
items.content: Create a sensitive email apologizing to [Recipient Name] for [Specific Action/Issue]. Express regret, explain briefly, and propose [Solution/Next Steps]. Maintain a respectful tone.

items.title: # Master Behavioral Questions
items.content: Act as an interviewer. Ask me 3 common behavioral questions for a [Job Role] interview. I will answer, then you provide constructive feedback on my response.

items.title: # Summarize Company Info
items.content: Analyze this company website: [Company Website URL]. Summarize their mission, recent news, and key values in bullet points. Focus on details relevant to a [Job Role] interview.

items.title: # Generate Interview Questions
items.content: Based on this job description: [Paste Job Description Here], generate 5 specific interview questions that an interviewer might ask for this [Job Role]. Include a mix of technical and soft skills.

items.title: # Refine My Answers
items.content: I'm preparing for a [Job Role] interview. Here's my answer to '[Interview Question]': [Your Answer]. Evaluate my answer for clarity, conciseness, and relevance. Suggest improvements.
